meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会通过 BGPT MCP 服务器检索科学论文,并按篇返回从全文提取的结构化实验数据:方法、定量结果、样本量、质量评分、结论等 25+ 个字段,而不只是标题和摘要。
howto.when: 需要从论文全文而非摘要里找实验细节(如定量结果、样本量、方法学比较)、或做文献综述与证据表时使用;前提是先在 agent 的 MCP 配置里接好 BGPT 服务器。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude searches scientific papers via the BGPT MCP server and returns structured full-text data per paper: methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores and 25+ fields, not just abstracts.
howto.when_en: Use it for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, or finding experimental details such as quantitative results, sample sizes and methods that abstracts lack. The BGPT MCP server must be configured first.
